newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez chrmn wants Frere among top holders.
newsitem.headline: Suez chrmn wants Frere among top holders.

text.p: Cie de Suez Chairman Gerard Mestrallet said he wants Belgian investor Albert Frere to be among Suez' top shareholders, daily Le Figaro reported on Monday.

"It seemed to me desirable for Cie de Suez to have a significant Belgian shareholder, and Albert Frere was already a long-term partner in Tractebel," Mestrallet said in an interview granted to the daily.
"My wish is that Albert Frere be at the level of the biggest, which will reinforce the ties between our two companies and our teams."
He went on to say that Suez' capital was open and he was setting no limits on anybody's participation.
"My job is to be responsible to my shareholders who are the company's owners. Suez is a company with capital open to the international financial markets," Mestrallet said.
